question: Leander starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards east. He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns left and drives 3 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
solution:
Given: 

Leander starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards east.

He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns left and drives 3 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32db8f111356fbe8627d8863a6c7240f9b7db4994c4741844cd5736cdefefd61.png] 

So,He should drive **7 km towards south** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
